title: koeleria spicata subsp. phleoides
intro: Koeleria spicata subsp. phleoides, commonly known as small hair-grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, and prevent infections. The plant is also reported to have therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and antiseptic properties, and its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and uses of Koeleria spicata subsp. phleoides.
